_readme: Contract for the ElevenLabs text-to-SFX generation pipeline. Each entry becomes `variations` generated takes stored as assets/sfx/<id>-<n>.ogg. `replaces` names the AudioBus.play() cue the sample supersedes or layers with (null = brand-new cue with no synth predecessor). Priority 1 is the first generation batch (feel-transforming: swings, impacts, parry, beam) and is capped at 40 entries. AudioBus stays as the fallback synth when a sample is missing; pan/throttle/voice-cap logic in AudioBus.ts remains authoritative — samples plug in at the recipe layer, not the dispatcher.

categories.description: Melee swing whooshes per combo family (arc swords, greatswords, dagger/claw rakes+lunges, hammer fulcrum-flip, fists, thrusts, tome page-flips). The swing IS the whiff sound: AudioBus fires melee:* on every swing and layers a separate impact cue only on contact, so no dedicated whiff assets are needed — dry, short-tail swings read as whiffs on their own.
Gun muzzle reports per bulletKind and per element, plus the full held-beam lifecycle (charge, ignition, sustain loop, redline warning, release, overheat blowout) shared by all 23 beam weapons.
Projectile/melee landings by target material (flesh, armor, stone), magnitude cues (crush, hammer-slam quake), elemental impact layers, kill confirms by enemy size tier, and player hurt.
The skill beat: success clang, the empowered-return escalation, and the pre-window weapon-glint shimmer that telegraphs timing.
Center-mono hit-marker grammar: normal, armor, rapid-stream grain, critical, and kill confirmation.
Ultimate readiness, unlock/temper ceremonies, and distinct material-rich phase cues for every archetype.
Serraketh the worm (dive, underground rumble, eruption, segment sever, regrow, death) plus the generic colossus slam.
Mirrored-L dock ticks and open/close, level-up ceremony set, card reveal/confirm, extract, revive.
One looping bed per dimension theme (Wild West, Frostfell, Verdant Ruins, Ashlands, Neon-Cyber) plus the stage-descent transition.
Footsteps per zone floor material, jump, land, dodge, pit death.
XP Echo mote catches (engine pitch-ramps a neutral take across the catch streak, mirroring AudioBus xpTick's 430->930 Hz amt ramp), the cadence resolve, and rarity-scaled loot stings.

sounds.prompt: Light one-handed sword cut recorded close: a nicked steel blade parts air over a leather grip creak and faint sleeve scrape, with layered sharp transient, dirty analog texture, tape saturation, and a small untreated room-tone tail. Fast, physical, no impact, no music, no chiptune, no synthesized bleeps, dense and gritty.
sounds.notes: Arc-family steps 1-2. Doubles as the whiff sound when no impact layer follows. AudioBus amt >= 0.75 marks the local player's own swing; keep takes tonally identical so amt only maps to gain.

sounds.prompt: Heavy broad-sword sweep recorded close: battered steel shoves a thick wall of air while leather bindings strain and the blade gives a dull uneven whistle, layered low transient, analog texture, tape saturation, and a short grimy room-tone tail. Weighty, physical, no impact, no music, no chiptune, no synthesized bleeps, dense and gritty.
sounds.notes: Arc-family step-3 finisher and generic heavy sweeps (glaive/halberd/axe reuse this).

sounds.prompt: Massive two-handed greatsword horizontal swing, huge slab of steel shoving a wall of air aside, slow heavy whoosh with low-frequency body and faint metal shimmer, deliberate pace, short tail, no impact, no music.
sounds.notes: Greatsword combo step 1 (slash). The 3-step rhythm needs distinct steps: 1 is wide and level.

sounds.prompt: Massive two-handed greatsword rising diagonal cut, heavy steel accelerating upward through air, whoosh that sweeps from low to slightly higher pitch as it rises, weighty body, short tail, no impact, no music.
sounds.notes: Greatsword combo step 2 (rising-chop) — upward pitch contour distinguishes it from step 1.

sounds.prompt: Enormous overhead execution slam with a two-handed greatsword, blade hauled up then driven straight down, air tearing downward with accelerating whoosh that drops in pitch, ends abruptly at the bottom of the arc, no ground impact included, no music.
sounds.notes: Greatsword step-3 execution-slam finisher. Pair with impact-crush or impact-hammer-slam on ground contact.

sounds.prompt: Very fast small dagger slash, short thin blade flicking through air, tight snappy swish, high and airy, extremely short with an instant dry stop, no impact, no music.
sounds.notes: Rake-family dagger variant, steps 1-2 of the flurry. Needs to survive rapid repetition at 34 ms throttle without fatigue — keep transients clean, zero tail.

sounds.prompt: Quick forward lunge stab with a dagger, body darting forward with a short cloth-and-air rush followed by a needle-thin blade hiss extending away, fast attack, brief tail, no impact, no music.
sounds.notes: The dagger/claw outside-line lunge and step-through impale steps — the movement rush is the identity, distinct from the flat flurry slashes.

sounds.prompt: Double claw rake recorded as real-material foley: two rough curved steel talons scissor through air a few milliseconds apart, with leather wrist-wrap snap, scratched metal edge, layered twin transients, analog texture, tape saturation, and a tiny dirty room tail. No impact, no music, no chiptune, no synthesized bleeps, dense and gritty.
sounds.notes: Rake family scissor step — the delayed second hand is authored in melee.ts; baking a subtle doubled swish into the asset sells it.

sounds.prompt: Huge warhammer front-flip windmill swing, a massive stone-and-steel hammer head whirling through a full vertical rotation, long swelling whoosh that rises then plunges in pitch like a rotating doppler, heavy air displacement, cuts off at the bottom of the arc, no ground impact, no music.
sounds.notes: The fulcrum-flip quake super-slam windup (the ICONIC hammer move). Always followed by impact-hammer-slam on landing.

sounds.prompt: Powerful bare-fist haymaker punch through air, a big arm hauling through a wide arc, meaty low whoosh with cloth rustle from the sleeve, committed and heavy, very short tail, no impact, no music.
sounds.notes: Punch-family step 3 (haymaker/hammerfist). Gauntlet weapons (20 in the expansion roster) reuse this with the impact layer carrying the metal.

sounds.prompt: Rapier thrust, a thin springy steel blade darting straight forward, sharp brief hiss with a faint flexing metal sing, precise and needle-like, instant stop, no impact, no music.
sounds.notes: Thrust family (rapier/spear/partisan stinger steps). Differentiated from arc lights by the straight-line hiss instead of a sweep.

sounds.prompt: Heavy spellbook page flip cast, thick parchment pages riffling fast then snapping shut, dry paper flutter with a leather cover thump at the end, small sparkling airy shimmer trailing off, short tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Tome/grimoire/compendium/psalter family cast action. The paper is the identity; the shimmer hints the spell without committing to an element (element lands via the impact layer).

sounds.prompt: Quick straight jab punch through air, compact fist snap with a tight short whoosh and light cloth flick, snappy and dry, no tail, no impact, no music.
sounds.notes: Punch-family steps 1-2 (jab/hook). P2 because swing-fist-haymaker anchors the family feel in batch 1.

sounds.prompt: Single heavy revolver report recorded close in a dusty stone room: violent powder crack, blunt low-mid muzzle bark, real steel cylinder and hammer clack, grit kicked from the floor, layered transient, analog texture, tape saturation, and a short uneven room-tone tail. No ricochet melody, no music, no chiptune, no synthesized bleeps, dense and gritty.
sounds.notes: The default physical pistol/hand-cannon/lever-rifle report. Fired at up to 33 Hz post-throttle; transient-forward, minimal tail.

sounds.prompt: Close twelve-gauge shotgun blast in a battered stone-and-timber room: wide concussive powder boom, dense chest thump, steel action clack, pellet grit and dust spray, layered cracked transient, analog texture, tape saturation, and a rough medium-short room-tone tail. No music, no chiptune, no synthesized bleeps, dense and gritty.
sounds.notes: Shotgun/blunderbuss/scrap-cannon families.

sounds.prompt: One industrial pneumatic nailgun discharge recorded close: compressed-air cough, greasy steel piston snap, nail biting scrap wood and a tiny metal chatter, layered hard transient, analog texture, tape saturation, and barely-there workshop room tone. No musical ring, no chiptune, no synthesized bleeps, dense and gritty.
sounds.notes: Nailgun/machine-pistol rapid fire — the 35 ms throttle means this repeats constantly; keep it small and dry.

sounds.prompt: Small energy pistol shot, a short zippy electric pew with a tight synthetic transient and a faint charged-air fizz, light and quick, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Tracer bulletKind (energy sidearms, wands on the light end).

sounds.prompt: Gunshot firing a ricochet round, a mid-weight pistol crack immediately followed by a springy metallic twang as the round spins away, playful bounce character, short tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Ricochet bulletKind muzzle. The bounce itself uses impact-ricochet.

sounds.prompt: Fire-element hand cannon shot, a deep concussive boom wrapped in an igniting whoosh of flame, burst of burning gas venting from the muzzle, ember crackle in the tail, medium tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Layer or replacement for fire-element guns (hand-cannon family and the fiery blast weapons). Element identity lives in the muzzle, not just the impact.

sounds.prompt: Frost-element rifle shot, a muffled icy crack like a frozen lake splitting, sharp crystalline shatter transient with a cold airy hiss of freezing vapor trailing off, brittle and glassy, short tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Frost-element guns and frost scepter bolts.

sounds.prompt: Lightning-element gun discharge, a snappy electric arc crack like a capacitor dumping, bright zap with sizzling static fringe and a faint ozone fizz after, very fast, minimal tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Shock element (tesla gatling, voltcaster, storm rods). Also reusable as the storm-call augment zap.

sounds.prompt: Void-element weapon shot, a reversed-sounding implosive thump where air rushes inward before a hollow dark pop, deep sub swallow with a thin eerie whistle bleeding off, unsettling, short tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Void element (null grimoire, voidwell idol, nullsaint). The inward-suck pre-transient is the signature.

sounds.prompt: Toxic-element launcher shot, a wet pressurized splat launch like thick acid spat from a tube, gloopy transient with a hissing corrosive fizz tail, organic and nasty, short tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Toxic element muzzle.

sounds.prompt: Arcane staff bolt cast, a smooth harmonic pulse leaving the staff tip, soft glassy chime transient with a whispering magical shimmer trailing away, elegant, short tail, no melody, no music.
sounds.notes: Arcane element (staff/orb/focus families).

sounds.prompt: Holy-element relic discharge, a warm resonant bell-like pulse with a burst of bright airy radiance, soft golden shimmer decaying quickly, reverent but percussive, short tail, single strike, no melody.
sounds.notes: Holy element (psalter, monstrance, reliquary weapons).

sounds.prompt: Energy beam weapon charging up, a rising electrical whine swelling from low hum to tense high pitch over about a second, capacitor filling with crackling static building underneath, ends at peak tension without firing, no music.
sounds.notes: Pre-ignition rise for all 23 beam weapons. AudioBus scales gain/pitch by amt (charge fraction); asset should end hot so ignition can interrupt it anywhere.

sounds.prompt: Energy beam ignition crack, an instant high-voltage snap like a giant arc striking, sharp bright transient with a split-second air-splitting boom and a fast electric sizzle settle, very short, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: The phase edge between charge and sustain. Must read instantly even under a full horde mix — transient-first.

sounds.prompt: Continuous energy beam sustain, a steady focused plasma stream, layered low electric hum with a tight mid-frequency sizzle and faint air ionization crackle, perfectly seamless loop, constant intensity, no swells, no music.
sounds.notes: Replaces the throttled pulse hack: with a real loop the engine crossfades one looping voice per ownerId (AudioBus already keys sustain per owner, bounded to 16 channels) instead of re-triggering. Author loop-clean at both ends.

sounds.prompt: Overheating machinery warning pulse, a strained high metallic stress whine with an urgent electronic chirp, like a reactor alarm blipping once, tense and piercing but very short, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Fired at 260 ms throttle while heat is critical — reads as a pulsing alarm through repetition. Critical voice priority.

sounds.prompt: Energy beam powering down, the plasma stream cutting out with a quick descending electric wind-down, residual sizzle dissipating and a soft pressure-release hiss like hot metal ticking as it cools, gentle tail under a second, no music.
sounds.notes: The clean let-go. Distinct from overheat: this is controlled, falling, relieved.

sounds.prompt: Weapon overheat blowout, a violent steam-and-spark burst as machinery force-vents, harsh pressurized gas explosion with metal stress groan and electrical fizzle collapsing downward in pitch, punishing and final, medium tail, no music.
sounds.notes: The failure state — must feel like a mistake, clearly harsher than beam-release. Critical priority at high amt.

sounds.prompt: Blade impact into dense flesh built from real wet hide, raw meat, leather, and a faint bone knock: layered hard cut transient, heavy organic thud, fibrous tear, analog texture, tape saturation, and a short dirty room-tone tail. No scream, no music, no chiptune, no synthesized bleeps, dense and gritty.
sounds.notes: The default hit layer for organic enemies (critters, vine-lashers, revenants). 25 ms throttle — highest-frequency sound in the game, so 4 variations to fight fatigue. amt scales gain only.

sounds.prompt: Weapon slams into dented steel armor over leather padding: layered brutal metal transient, plate buckle, rivet chatter, short abrasive scrape, analog texture, tape saturation, and a cramped dirty room-tone tail. Damped and physical, no clean bell, no music, no chiptune, no synthesized bleeps, dense and gritty.
sounds.notes: Armored kinds (vault-ronin, killbots, the Frozen Knight). Damped ring keeps horde-density mixes readable.

sounds.prompt: Weapon impact against rough stone recorded close: layered mineral crack and dense rock thock, chips, sand, and mortar grit scattering across the floor, analog texture, tape saturation, and a short dusty room-tone tail. No clean synthetic snap, no music, no chiptune, no synthesized bleeps, dense and gritty.
sounds.notes: Golems, slag-crawlers, temple constructs, and environment/prop hits.

sounds.prompt: Crushing heavy blow landing, a deep concussive body thud with bone-deep low-end punch, a compressed crunch layered over a bass drop, brief debris rattle after, weighty, short-medium tail, no music.
sounds.notes: The magnitude cue — crits, finisher connects, charged hits. 60 ms throttle.

sounds.prompt: Colossal hammer slamming into the ground, a massive earth-shaking quake impact, sub-bass boom with cracking rock, dirt and pebbles showering back down, low rumble dissipating over a second, huge and cinematic, no music.
sounds.notes: Landing of the fulcrum-flip super-slam and true-charged-slam. Sits under the screen shake; pairs with swing-hammer-flip.

sounds.prompt: Bullet ricocheting off a hard surface, a bright metallic ping with a springy whining zing bending away in pitch, classic bounce, quick decay, no music.
sounds.notes: The bounce event for ricochet rounds (currently the shot:ricochet recipe covers both fire and bounce).

sounds.prompt: Small fire burst on impact, a quick fwoosh of flame catching with popping embers and a crackling flare, hot airy bloom that snuffs out fast, short tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Element layer stacked over the material hit for fire weapons; also serves ember-eruption fx-pack accents.

sounds.prompt: Ice crystallizing on impact, a sharp glassy crackle of frost spreading fast over a surface, brittle crystalline shimmer with tiny ice shards tinkling, cold and thin, short tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Frost element layer; the frost-nova fx-pack can reuse a longer-gain variant.

sounds.prompt: Electric shock on impact, a snappy arcing zap with branching static crackle, bright buzzy discharge that sputters out instantly, sharp and fast, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Shock element layer; chain-lightning arcs re-trigger it per jump under the hit throttle.

sounds.prompt: Acid splashing on impact, a wet corrosive splat with bubbling sizzle as the surface dissolves, gloopy body and fizzy hissing tail, gross and organic, short tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Toxic element layer; toxic-burst fx-pack accent.

sounds.prompt: Void implosion on impact, air sucked sharply inward then a muffled hollow collapse, reversed whoosh into a dark sub thump with a faint dissonant whisper trailing, unnatural, short tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Void element layer; void-implosion fx-pack accent.

sounds.prompt: Arcane energy bursting on impact, a soft glassy chime-crack with a swirl of sparkling magical dust dissipating, smooth harmonic body, quick shimmer decay, single strike, no melody.
sounds.notes: Arcane element layer.

sounds.prompt: Holy smite landing, a warm radiant thump like a padded bell struck once, bright golden bloom of air with a fast reverent decay, clean and pure, short tail, single strike, no melody.
sounds.notes: Holy element layer; holy-smite fx-pack accent.

sounds.prompt: Small creature bursting on death, a quick soft pop with a light wet splat and a puff of air, small-bodied and satisfying, snappy, very short tail, no scream, no music.
sounds.notes: Size tier: critters, mote-swarms (radius 12-18). Horde staple — 30 ms throttle in AudioBus.

sounds.prompt: Medium creature death, a solid body collapse thud with a wet burst and brief bone crunch, grounded weight hitting the floor, short tail, no scream, no music.
sounds.notes: Size tier: standard enemies (radius 22-30: pricklepulp, boothill, ronin, grull).

sounds.prompt: Large heavy creature death fall, a big meaty ground-shaking collapse with a deep thud, cracking impact and debris settling, weighty finality with a low rumble tail, medium tail, no scream, no music.
sounds.notes: Size tier: elites (radius 64-72: kaido, blade-twins, vault bosses). The reward beat for a tough kill.

sounds.prompt: Colossal titan death collapse, an enormous slow-motion structural fall, deep sub-bass groan into a massive multi-stage ground impact with rockslide debris and a long dust-settling rumble tail, cinematic scale, no scream, no music.
sounds.notes: Size tier: dimensional-colossus / world-titan (radius 170-230).

sounds.prompt: Player taking damage, a dull painful body thump with a muffled low-end punch and a brief breathy grunt-like air exhale, internal and close, short tail, no voice words, no music.
sounds.notes: Critical voice priority in AudioBus; 120 ms throttle. Keep the vocal element abstract — no gendered voice.

sounds.prompt: Perfect sword parry: two battered steel blades collide hard, edge scrape and guard rattle over leather-handled weight, layered explosive metal transient, imperfect forged resonance, analog texture, tape saturation, and a brief stone-room tail. Heroic but dirty, no clean bell, no music, no chiptune, no synthesized bleeps, dense and gritty.
sounds.notes: THE skill beat — AudioBus calls it the crispest sound in the game and gives it critical priority. Must cut through everything; leave headroom, mix hot.

sounds.prompt: Empowered deflection return strike, a huge steel clang immediately swallowed by a rising energized whoosh as the attack is hurled back charged with power, metallic ring blooming into a bright ascending surge, triumphant escalation, medium tail, no melody.
sounds.notes: The escalation layer when a parry sends an empowered projectile/strike back — plays instead of (not over) parry-clang; the pitch rise IS the power-up read.

sounds.prompt: A quick weapon glint shimmer, a single soft crystalline sparkle like light flashing off a polished blade edge, airy high shimmer with an instant swell and fast fade, subtle and short, no melody.
sounds.notes: Visual-only generic parry glint asset; there is currently no AudioBus cue site for it. Vastaghar's runtime glint resolves separately through vastaghar-glint -> boss:titan:glint.

sounds.prompt: Giant worm diving into the earth, a massive body plunging underground with a deep soil-shearing whoomph, dirt and rocks cascading into the collapsing hole, heavy earthen suction, rumbling tail sinking away, no roar, no music.
sounds.notes: Serraketh burrow entry (WormBossVfx.emitDiveDust). Pans with the dive point; the fading tail hands off to serraketh-rumble-loop.

sounds.prompt: Something enormous tunneling underground, a continuous deep seismic rumble with grinding earth and rock, low subterranean churning with occasional muffled cracks, felt more than heard, seamless loop, constant menace, no music.
sounds.notes: Plays while Serraketh is burrowed, gain/pan tracking the burrow trail head (drawBurrowTrail). Loop-clean; the engine ducks it during eruption.

sounds.prompt: Colossal worm erupting from the ground, an explosive earth burst with tons of soil and rock blasting upward, deep sub-bass detonation, a huge shredding roar of displaced earth, debris raining back down in the tail, terrifying scale, medium-long tail, no music.
sounds.notes: The signature Serraketh moment (emitEruption + eruption paint). Critical priority; sits under the big shake.

sounds.prompt: Severing a giant armored worm segment, a massive wet chitinous crack as thick carapace splits, deep fibrous tearing with a heavy segment thudding to the ground, visceral and huge, ichor splatter in the tail, no scream, no music.
sounds.notes: The segment-sever reward beat (emitSever) — the player's big damage milestone against the worm.

sounds.prompt: Monstrous flesh regrowing, wet organic tissue knitting and swelling with slick squelches and stretching sinew creaks, chitin plates clicking back into place at the end, unsettling reversed-growth character, medium tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Segment regrow (emitRegrowth) — the threat-escalation counterpart to sever; should make players wince.

sounds.prompt: Gigantic worm dying, a long agonized structural collapse, deep groaning body crashing down in stages with earth-shaking impacts, carapace cracking apart, final massive thud into a long settling rumble with debris and dust, epic finality, long tail, no music.
sounds.notes: The boss-kill payoff; plays over the death VFX sequence, everything else ducked.

sounds.prompt: Giant fist or limb slamming the ground, a huge concussive earth impact with deep sub boom, cracking stone and a shockwave of displaced air, debris scatter in the tail, massive weight, medium tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Dimensional-colossus / world-titan slams and any non-worm boss ground pound.

sounds.prompt: Tiny interface tick, a single soft clean click like a smooth mechanical detent, minimal and precise, instant, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Mirrored-L dock selection ticks and hover steps. Must be near-inaudible filler, not a beep.

sounds.prompt: Interface panel sliding open, a short smooth mechanical glide with a soft cushioned latch at the end, quiet and tactile, subtle air movement, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Dock expand.

sounds.prompt: Interface panel sliding closed, a short smooth mechanical glide ending in a gentle click shut, slightly lower in pitch than an opening motion, quiet and tactile, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Dock collapse — authored as the falling mirror of ui-dock-open.

sounds.prompt: Card hover blip, a featherlight paper slide with the faintest airy shimmer, extremely quiet and short, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Level-up choice card hover / dock card focus.

sounds.prompt: Card selection confirm, a crisp card snap laid onto a surface with a small warm sparkle accent, decisive and satisfying, very short tail, single note of shimmer only, no melody.
sounds.notes: Choosing an augment card / pickup confirm. Replaces the two-tone grab blip.

sounds.prompt: Triumphant level-up burst, a bright ascending magical surge of energy with a warm bloom and glittering sparkle shower cascading down after the peak, celebratory and radiant, one gesture rising then settling, medium tail, no drums.
sounds.notes: The ceremony headline — replaces the 4-note synth arpeggio. Musical contour intended here.

sounds.prompt: Time dilating into slow motion, a smooth deep downward whoosh like the world decelerating, air pressure dropping with a soft sub swell and everything going hushed, dreamlike, gentle tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Entry into the level-up ceremony slow-mo; the reversed variant (engine plays it backwards or a mirrored take) exits it.

sounds.prompt: Magical card flipping face-up, a quick paper flip with a soft whoosh and a bright sparkling flourish as the face reveals, elegant and quick, short shimmer tail, no melody.
sounds.notes: Per-card reveal in the ceremony; stagger-played across the three choices.

sounds.prompt: Dimensional extraction surge, a big rising energy swell whooshing upward and away with a shimmering portal warble and a deep receding boom at the end, powerful departure, medium tail, no melody.
sounds.notes: Run extraction — the 'you made it out' punctuation.

sounds.prompt: Ally revival surge, a warm swelling breath of energy flowing back into a body, soft rising glow with a gentle heartbeat-like double thump and a bright hopeful shimmer settling, restorative, medium tail, no melody.
sounds.notes: Co-op revive — the emotional beat of the mode; warm, not triumphant.

sounds.prompt: Tiny energy mote absorbed, a single soft glassy pluck with a micro shimmer, like a droplet of light popping into the chest, clean pure tone body, instant decay, no tail, no melody.
sounds.notes: AudioBus ramps xpTick pitch with amt (430 to 930 Hz across the catch streak). Generate at neutral pitch with a clean harmonic body so the engine can playbackRate-shift roughly 1.0x to 1.8x across the streak without artifacts. Low voice priority, 65 ms throttle.

sounds.prompt: Gentle energy absorption resolve, a soft warm upward glissando shimmer settling into stillness, like a handful of light dissolving into the body at once, restrained and round, short tail, single gesture.
sounds.notes: The batch-catch resolve that caps a mote streak (300 ms throttle) — must stay quieter than loot and never impersonate the level-up fanfare.

sounds.prompt: Treasure materializing, a bright crystalline chime bloom with cascading sparkle dust, magical and inviting, clear bell-like attack with a glittering decay, short-medium tail, single strike, no melody.
sounds.notes: AudioBus pitches loot up with rarity (amt = rarity/6); as with xp-mote-catch, generate neutral and let the engine pitch-shift per rarity tier, or map the 3 variations to common/rare/legendary bands.

sounds.prompt: Single boot footstep on dry hardpan desert dirt, a soft gritty scuff with fine sand crunch, dusty and dry, close perspective, very short, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Wild West (dimension 1) floor material — the default stage, so it leads the footstep set at P2.

sounds.prompt: Single boot footstep on packed snow with a thin ice crust, a crisp compressing crunch with a faint brittle crackle, cold and dense, very short, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Frostfell floor material (black-ice slicks get an occasional slip variant later).

sounds.prompt: Single boot footstep on wet moss over ancient stone, a soft damp squish with a muted stone tap underneath, organic and cushioned, very short, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Verdant Ruins floor material.

sounds.prompt: Single boot footstep on loose volcanic cinder and ash, a dry brittle crunch of charcoal fragments with a powdery hiss, hollow and crumbly, very short, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Ashlands floor material.

sounds.prompt: Single boot footstep on a hard chrome metal deck plate, a clean dense metallic tap with a tiny damped ring, industrial and precise, very short, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Neon-Cyber floor material.

sounds.prompt: Character jumping, a quick effortful cloth-and-air push-off whoosh with a light foot scuff at launch, agile and springy, very short, no voice, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Direct id convention: AudioBus jump calls sampleBank.playSample(player-jump); material-agnostic across floor sets.

sounds.prompt: Character landing from a jump, a compact two-part impact of boots hitting ground with a soft knee-bend cloth rustle, weighty but agile, very short tail, no voice, no music.
sounds.notes: Direct id convention: AudioBus land calls sampleBank.playSample(player-land) and rate/gain carries the three landing tiers; replaces=fall also serves void-fall recovery.

sounds.prompt: Fast evasive dash, a short sharp body whoosh with cloth snap and a whisper of displaced air, urgent lateral burst, instant stop, no tail, no music.
sounds.notes: Direct id convention: AudioBus leap:launch calls sampleBank.playSample(player-dodge) for the evasive movement burst.

sounds.prompt: Falling away into a deep pit, a descending doppler whoosh receding downward and getting smaller, air rushing past fading to silence with a tiny distant final thump, comic-tragic timing, medium tail, no scream, no music.
sounds.notes: The mineshaft/pit fall — the receding pitch drop is the joke; keep the distant thump barely audible.

sounds.prompt: Descending between dimensions, a big smooth falling whoosh through rushing air with a deep swelling sub drone and a shimmering reality-tear crackle at the edges, arriving with a soft pressurized landing woomph, cinematic transition, medium tail, no melody.
sounds.notes: Stage-to-stage drop ('Dust & The Drop'). The one transition sting shared by all five dimensions.

sounds.prompt: Desert badlands ambience, dry wind gusting over open hardpan with sparse sand hiss, distant tumbleweed rustle, occasional far-off hawk cry, empty and sun-baked, seamless loop, sparse and quiet, no music.
sounds.notes: Dimension 1 bed. All beds mix at very low gain under combat and duck further during boss phases.

sounds.prompt: Frozen cathedral ambience, cold hollow wind moaning through high stone arches, ice creaking and faint crystalline tinkles, a barely-audible ghostly choral drone frozen mid-note far in the background, reverberant and sacred, seamless loop, no rhythm.
sounds.notes: Frostfell ('the cathedral froze mid-prayer') — the faint choir is intentional, per the Frozen Choir lore; keep it drone-like, never melodic.

sounds.prompt: Overgrown jungle temple ambience, dense insect chorus and dripping water echoing off mossy stone, distant bird calls, creaking vines and soft spore-pod pops, humid and alive, seamless loop, no music.
